If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over last 5 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) over last 5 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to offset pessimism.  
In mid-horizon (8–15 days), if sentiment swings from positive to negative, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% per sentiment shift to reflect volatility.  
In late-horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33) and forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is positive but forecast is trending downward, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% in mid-horizon to align with sentiment momentum.  
If sentiment is negative but forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% in mid-horizon to prevent sentiment mismatch.
